preferences.text: I prefer natural, imperfect conversations. Characters should not explain every feeling directly. Humor should emerge from personality and situations.
I prefer character-specific humor based on behavior, personal flaws, relationships, and bad decisions. Avoid generic witty one-liners and familiar rom-com character templates.

My comedy preference: I like characters who are naturally funny without trying to be comedians. They may say inappropriate things even during serious situations without realizing it. Their spontaneous dialogue, expressions, reactions, and attempts to cover up what they said create comedy. I prefer humor that emerges naturally from the character's personality and situation, rather than planned punchlines.

When helping me develop characters, understand my creative thinking rather than giving me generic writing advice. I imagine scenes, dialogues, expressions, reactions, conflicts, and story opportunities. Help me develop my ideas without replacing them with your own generic ideas.
I prefer comedy based on character behavior, not forced punchlines.
Comedy should emerge from character behaviour and bad decisions, not forced punchlines.
